failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 3: 'What is "Making North America" and who produced it? Is it a documentary film? What documentaries has Incite Productions produced and what are their styles?' This is a compound multi-part query bundling several distinct targets (existence, producer, classification, Incite Productions' work, and styles) into natural-language yes/no question format.

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query at hop 2: 'Making North America documentary film' and Query at hop 3: 'What is "Making North America" and who produced it? Is it a documentary film? What documentaries has Incite Productions produced and what are their styles?' Both queries target the same entities (Making North America and Incite Productions) without substantive advancement. Hop 3 retrieves largely the same documents as hop 1 (Incite Productions passage appears in both hop 1 and hop 3 results).

failure_modes.name: Multi_Hop_Context_Degradation
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_2 reasoning states: 'Summary_1 indicates that "Making North America" is not mentioned in the provided passages...while summary_2 states that "Making North America" is confirmed as a 2015 American documentary film...This discrepancy suggests that the passages available to each summary differ significantly.' The coordinator incorrectly attributes the presence of the Making North America passage to different passage sets when both summaries had access to hop 2 results containing this information, showing failure to maintain coherent tracking of what evidence was retrieved when.

failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states under 'Unverified Elements': 'The film "Making North America" is not mentioned in any of the provided passages. To verify this claim completely, the following information is needed: Confirmation that a film titled "Making North America" exists.' However, hop 2 retrieval results provided to the solver included: 'Making North America (film) | Making North America is a 2015 American documentary film which premiered nationwide on November 4, 2015.'
